release_version.description: Version passed to AppRegistry.publishRelease and hashed into releaseId. Defaults to upstream.version; bump it when only the packaging changes. The release tag is <id>-v<version> with a leading v before a digit dropped (v1.58.2 is tagged <id>-v1.58.2); lint refuses + and any other leading v (D-046).

name.description: Short name; mirrored as <catalog.registry>/<name>@<digest> and referenced in fragments as {{image:<name>}}

source.description: Upstream reference including tag, or 'build:images/<dir>' for images built by the runtime image workflow

ref.description: Written by the bundle builder as <catalog.registry>/<name>@<digest>. Never set in catalog sources.

path_or_host.description: host label (route name) or a path prefix starting with /

auth.description: gate (password gate) for every app UI. Only llm-gateway route gateway may use bearer-passthrough and only inference-relay route relay may use public; the composer rejects anything else.

on_attest_host.description: Serve this route's path prefix on the attest host (same origin and TLS certificate as /attest, D-045) instead of its own host. Allowed only for the route named relay, which must then use a path prefix such as /v1.

http.description: path probed on the primary service, for example /healthz

name.description: Environment variable name, at most 128 characters. It may not be a variable the composer sets (proxy variables, NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY, SEALED_PUBLIC_URL_*) or a telemetry_off_env key.

generate.description: how sealed secrets set --generate creates a value when the customer does not supply one: hex32 is 32 random bytes as 64 lowercase hex characters, base64-32 is 32 random bytes in standard base64 with padding, sk-hex32 is sk- followed by hex32, password is 24 characters drawn uniformly from [A-Za-z0-9]. Must be none when same_as is set.

same_as.description: <appId>/<NAME>: this secret has the value of another app's secret (D-043). The composer requires that app to be in the stack, to declare that secret and to list this app in the secret's share_with (D-059); the key broker returns the value under this app's name, and sealed secrets never asks for it twice.

share_with.description: App ids that may reference this secret with same_as (D-059). Without an entry no other app can read the value. Not allowed on a secret that is itself a same_as reference.

telemetry_off_env.description: Env vars that disable telemetry and update checks; applied to every service of the app. Catalog lint requires at least one unless telemetry_none_reason is set.

telemetry_none_reason.description: Optional. Set only when telemetry_off_env is empty: why the app needs no telemetry switches (what was checked: upstream source, update checks, crash reporting). Reviewed in catalog PRs.

license_exclusions.description: Paths that are never shipped (enterprise directories, proprietary packages). CI fails if an SBOM or image layer contains them.

license_exceptions.description: Paths exempt from SBOM license and excluded-path findings, each under a recorded decision. Catalog lint accepts only the decision ids listed in runtime/composer/lint/exceptions.go (empty today), so every entry is a lint error until a decision adds its id there.

bootstrap.description: Optional one-shot job run inside the VM before the app's routes open (first admin, closing sign-up). The bootstrap service restarts on failure.

done_file.description: File the bootstrap job writes when it is done: <volume>/<path> relative to /mnt/sealed-data/<appId>/ (D-044: sealed-agent keeps the app's routes closed until it exists). Clean path without . or .. segments. The older form, an absolute path in bootstrap.service under one of its named-volume mounts, is still accepted and lint warns; a tmpfs path is rejected because the agent cannot see it.
